    • setMode

      public void setMode(String mode)
      Set the mode of the Feed. It can be any of the following:
      • RSSGenerator.MODE_WIKI - to create a wiki diff list per page.
      • RSSGenerator.MODE_BLOG - to assume that the Entries are blog entries.
      • RSSGenerator.MODE_FULL - to create a wiki diff list for the entire blog.
      As the Entry list itself is generated elsewhere, this mostly just affects the way that the layout and metadata for each entry is generated.
      Parameters:
      mode - As defined in RSSGenerator.
